jobs.description:
**The role and impact

**As the Head of Public Affairs, Denmark, you will be the primary architect of our political strategy, regulatory advocacy, and reputational standing in Denmark. Operating in a highly visible role, you will bridge the gap between our global business goals and the unique Danish political and societal landscape.

You will serve as the trusted face of the company to Danish government officials, regulators, trade associations, and civic leaders, while acting as a strategic advisor to our European executive leadership team.

Your success in this role ensures that our business not only navigates complex regulatory frameworks but actively shapes the policies that define our industry's future in Denmark.

**What you’ll bring

**Professional background: 15+ years of dedicated experience in government affairs, regulatory policy, public policy advocacy, or corporate-government relations in Denmark.

Educational foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, International Relations, or a strictly related field.

Strategic Advocacy & Lobbying: Develop and execute comprehensive public affairs campaigns to shape Danish policy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Political & Regulatory Intelligence: Actively monitor, analyze, and anticipate legislative developments in government ministries and relevant Danish agencies, translating complex political trends into actionable business intelligence for global leadership.

Stakeholder & Coalition Building: Build, maintain, and leverage a robust network of relationships with Danish policymakers, regulators, NGOs, think tanks, and industry trade associations (e.g., Dansk Industri). Lead management of framework agreement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs supporting engagement in regions across the world where Topsoe does not have a PA presence and collaborating closely with the regional PA teams, eg Brussels, etc. where we do.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with internal business units and communication teams to ensure Danish public affairs strategies support global corporate initiatives and commercial goals.

**Why join us

**At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen. And with your contributions, we’re shaping a more sustainable future with solutions that truly matter.

We prioritize the safety and well-being of our employees and are committed to maintaining a safe work environment where everyone looks out for each other's health and safety.

**Your new team

**The Head of PA, DK will report to the Head of Global Public Affairs and work closely with the broader Global Public Affairs team, with colleagues in Copenhagen, Brussels, the Middle East and Washington, DC.

**How you can apply

**If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

Application deadline: 8th November 2026

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

_To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

_**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

jobs.occupation: New Loop is looking for a full stack software developer
jobs.description:
New Loop's mission is to provide a sustainable alternative to single-use packaging through reusable packaging and a deposit-based return system.

You'll take technical ownership of an established production platform that currently keeps track of the deposits on more than 3.000.000 pieces of reusable packaging. The platform manages deposit state, deposit values, payouts and a web-based return flow used by consumers. New Loop also manages physical return boxes where consumers return their packaging. We're continuously developing both the software and the user experience around these boxes to make returning reusable packaging as simple and frictionless as possible for the user.

The role

We're a small company of 6–8 people, so you'll work directly with the rest of the company to understand what we're working to achieve, turn the needs into technical solutions, and build them. As the company grows you will have an opportunity to shape your role.

What you'll be responsible for

• 
Drive development of the New Loop platform across backend and frontend while keeping the platform maintainable and scalable as New Loop grows.

• 
Translate business problems and intentions into technical solutions.

• 
Take technical ownership of the codebase and architecture.

• 
Work directly with the rest of the organization to understand what needs to be built and why.

• 
Continuously improve the user experience around our physical return boxes and the software that supports them.

You'll have technical sparring with Brian Christensen (previously Too Good To Go), our technical adviser who developed New Loop's existing digital infrastructure, and knows the platform and the decisions behind it. So you'll have someone to draw on as you take ownership of its future development.

Who we're looking for

We're primarily looking for a strong developer and problem solver. You have a solid software engineering foundation and you should be able to understand the intent behind a business requirement while also being able to work with the rest of the company to find the best solution for a problem.

We're particularly interested in someone who:

• 
Is self-motivated and takes initiative.

• 
Enjoys taking ownership of a product and its technical decisions.

• 
Has strong programming and problem-solving fundamentals.

• 
Wants the freedom and responsibility that comes with working in a small company.

Experience with our exact stack is useful, but understanding software engineering and being able to learn matters more than matching every technology on the list.

We are currently utilizing AI for AI assisted development and the use of AI is encouraged as long as the code quality does not suffer.

Start date and salary

We expect you to start in late 2026. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience, while reflecting New Loop’s current stage as a startup. We’ll discuss the package openly during the recruitment process.

Interested?

If the combination of programming, technical ownership, physical products and solving real business problems sounds interesting, we'd like to hear from you.

Contact us at brian@newloop.dk.

Tech stack

Backend

Our backend is built in .NET / C# and handles container and deposit state, return sessions, payouts, payment integrations and the business processes around them.

The architecture is distributed and event-driven, with an emphasis on traceability and structured logging.

• 
.NET 10 / C#

• 
MongoDB

• 
Event sourcing

• 
Event-driven architecture

• 
Quartz.NET

• 
SQS

• 
Redis

• 
Structured logging

Frontend

Our frontend consists primarily of our administration system and the consumer-facing return flow.

The consumer experience is web-based by design: returning packaging should require as little friction as possible, so consumers don't need to install an app.

• 
React

• 
Next.js

• 
Sentry

Infrastructure

The platform runs on AWS and is deployed across multiple environments.

• 
AWS ECS

• 
AWS Amplify

• 
SQS

• 
Redis

• 
Docker

• 
Terraform

• 
Continuous deployment

• 
Infrastructure as code

• 
Automated testing and production monitoring

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our product team in Aarhus.

This is not a role where you only write code. You are a systems developer. A real part of your time goes into discovery, meaning analysis and design: understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and deciding what is worth building. The rest goes into delivery.

We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools are a natural part of how we design, write and review software, so more of the typing is handled for you. That makes the harder, more valuable work the judgement: what to build, how it fits together, and whether it holds up as the platform grows. We use AI to move faster, and we believe people are what make sure we build the right things.

Your work will reach hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change. Talking with the people who use the platform may be part of the job, so that what you build stays grounded in real needs.

What you will work on

Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.

We are actively building and improving core parts of the platform. You will:

Discovery (analysis and design)

• 
Work with product managers, designers and stakeholders to understand real user problems before we commit to building. AI helps us move fast, so the harder work is knowing what is worth building.

• 
Explore options, weigh tradeoffs, and decide what to build and how.

• 
Contribute to architecture and system design that keep the platform scalable and maintainable.

Delivery (development and operations)

• 
Design, build and maintain robust, scalable features across the platform.

• 
Write clean, maintainable code, using AI tools where they help and applying judgement to what they produce.

• 
Review code and designs, test and debug complex issues, and give constructive feedback.

• 
Operate what you build: CI/CD, containers and cloud, and refactor as the platform grows.

Quality and craft

• 
Meet security standards and protect user data in a data-sensitive sector.

• 
Share knowledge and mentor other engineers on craft and good practice. This is technical mentoring, not people management.

Who we are looking for

You are a senior engineer who is as comfortable in the problem as in the code. Your foundation is strong delivery, and your edge is at the front of the process: you know how to find the right problem before jumping to a solution, and how to do it at a pace that keeps up with a team that ships.

You will need:

• 
5+ years building software, ideally SaaS.

• 
Strong with PHP and Laravel, and with JavaScript and React.

• 
Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and running services in the cloud.

• 
A considered approach to AI in your workflow. You use modern AI coding tools well, and you review what they produce critically.

• 
Strong system and product thinking. You can take part in discovery, not only delivery.

• 
Clear communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a PM, a designer, and another engineer, and make it feel simple.

• 
A degree in computer science, engineering or similar, or an equivalent proven track record.

The kind of person who does well here:

• 
Curious about the problem, not only the code.

• 
Ownership mindset. You follow a problem all the way through.

• 
Comfortable making decisions without a perfect foundation, and honest about the tradeoffs when you do.

• 
Direct. You share work early, give feedback clearly, and push back when something is not right.

What the first six months look like

After one month

You understand the platform architecture, our discovery and delivery process, and the team. You have taken ownership of your first delivery tasks and you are part of discovery conversations and team ceremonies.

After three months

You are leading delivery of key features and contributing actively to discovery, helping shape solutions and technical direction for upcoming work. AI tools are a fluent part of your daily work.

After six months

You show leadership in system design and architecture decisions and influence technical direction. You own discovery for meaningful pieces of work, from problem to buildable plan, and you mentor other engineers on craft and good practice.

Working at Candeno

We are a scale-up. That means real ownership, real impact, and a product that is still being shaped by the people who work on it.

We are based in Aarhus, and this is an on-site role. The team is small, cross-functional, and works closely together. You will have real ownership of your work and close proximity to product, design and the rest of engineering.

We are direct and focused on doing the right thing for users. We share work early and expect you to do the same.

What we offer

• 
Pension scheme and health insurance

• 
5 extra days off after 2 years of seniority (10 in total)

• 
Daily lunch from Meyers Madhus

• 
A shared milestone programme that celebrates successes big and small

• 
An active social life: team events, clubs, and an engaged social committee

Before you apply

This is a fully on-site role in Aarhus with no remote option. You must already have the right to work in Denmark and be able to be in our office every working day from your start date. We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applications that do not meet these conditions will not be considered, so please only apply if all of them apply to you.

The process

• 
A short screening call

• 
A first interview, a deeper conversation about your experience and the role

• 
A case interview, a practical brief sent in advance

No cover letter. You will answer three short questions when you apply.

About Candeno

Candeno is a Nordic employment technology company based in Aarhus. We build the platform that connects candidates, advisors, and companies across municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Our work sits at the intersection of public sector compliance and modern product thinking, and we take both seriously.

For more information or questions please contact us at abt@candeno.com or phone number [+45 53 69 21 00](

In this IT Support role, you’ll be…

• 
Responsible for our internal IT environment, serving as the single point of contact for the tools, hardware, and access that 200+ colleagues rely on every day.

• 
The owner of our hardware and software lifecycle, managing procurement, provisioning, device enrollment, asset tracking, returns, repairs, and license administration end to end.

• 
Working closely with People Operations on onboarding and offboarding, so new joiners have everything they need on day one, and leavers lose access the same day. Together with Security, Legal and our system owners, you keep access controls audit-ready.

• 
Designing how we support colleagues across Europe. We will not hire IT support in every office, so you figure out how to give Milan, Munich and Madrid the same quality of support as Copenhagen, working with our office team as local hands.

• 
A proactive operator and process builder. This is a hands-on role: you will fix things today and fix the reason they broke tomorrow, turning repeat requests into documented self-service guides.

Who is the Employee Experience Team?

Employee Experience is part of the People team and brings People Operations, Workplace and IT together. We share one responsibility: a seamless work experience, so every colleague can do their best work, whichever office they sit in.

IT Support sits in Workplace because the tools you work with, the access you need and the office you work from together decide how easily your work starts and flows. Eventually we aim to work from one front door for questions, one ticketing system and one knowledge base, so colleagues don’t need to know who owns what to get help.

What you bring

• 
2–5 years in IT support or service desk, ideally somewhere growing fast enough that you had to build processes, not just follow them.

• 
Hands-on with macOS, device management (Kandji or Iru), Google Workspace, and an identity provider for SSO and access control.

• 
Experience supporting colleagues remotely and across locations, and ideas on how to make that scale.

• 
Real ownership: you break work into manageable pieces, take it to done with limited supervision, and flag early when something is slipping instead of hoping it resolves itself.

• 
Clear communication in English: you keep people updated on status without being chased, and you can clearly explain a fix to a non-technical colleague.

• 
A documenter by instinct: you'd rather write the process down once than answer the same question ten times.

What do we offer you?

• 
A monthly salary ranging from 31,000 to 39,000 DKK.

• 
Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• 
Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success

• 
A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need

• 
An office-first culture in a central location in Copenhagen (Skelbæksgade 2), with benefits including pension, lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• 
A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices

• 
Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects

Our recruitment process

• 
Send your application and upload relevant information

• 
15–30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

• 
30-minute online interview with our Head of Operations

• 
30-minute online interview with our VP People (Hiring Manager)

• 
Completion of Personality Assessment & Case Presentation

• 
60-minute in-person final interview with our Hiring Manager & other relevant stakeholder(s)

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich and Madrid. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to

Join us in this role where you’ll develop and improve core market models that support short- and mid-term analysis. You’ll combine strong Python development with an interest in energy markets to deliver scalable, reliable models used daily by trading and commercial teams.

**Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis

**You’ll be part of Forecasting & Market Analysis where you together with your colleagues will develop models and forecasts supporting trading and portfolio decisions across power and gas. You’ll work closely with analysts, traders, and platform teams to ensure high-quality data-driven insights. As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• developing our new gas supply and demand to enable our gas trading and portfolio management activities

• developing and improving gas and power market models for supply-demand and price formation.

• integrating key drivers such as weather, fuel prices, outages, and interconnector flows into models.

• ensuring model outputs reflect market behaviour across short- and mid-term horizons.

• improving model governance, monitoring performance, and keeping assumptions and data up to date.

• collaborating with traders, analysts, and developers to deliver actionable insights and recommendations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a background in quantitative development, engineering, economics, or similar, or equivalent experience.

• possess deep knowledge of European gas markets

• write scalable, well-tested Python code and apply modern development practices.

• are familiar with version control, CI/CD, and collaborative software development.

• work confidently with data, including time series analysis, SQL, and data visualisation tools.

• are motivated to build expertise in energy markets and translate it into models.

• communicate clearly and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr51,440.00- kr77,160.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Make finance processes work better, from end to end

Do you enjoy turning complex finance challenges into practical, well-controlled ways of working? Join the Global Finance Processes team at Scan Global Logistics A/S and help shape consistent processes that connect finance, business operations and technology.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Finance Process Manager to drive the design, implementation and continuous improvement of global finance processes. This role is central to ensuring consistency, efficiency and compliance across financial operations globally. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strong finance acumen, operational excellence and consulting experience(preferred), with the ability to lead change across diverse geographies and teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Process Design, Documentation & Implementation: Lead the development and standardization of global finance processes across accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, reporting and other core finance functions. Facilitate process design workshops with cross-functional stakeholders, and define, document and maintain comprehensive process maps and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance across regions and teams.

• Gap Analysis & Remediation: Identify process inefficiencies, control weaknesses and regional deviations, and implement actionable solutions to close gaps and enhance process maturity.

• Training & Change Management: Design and deliver training programs for regional finance teams to support the adoption of new processes and compliance with global standards.

• Project Management: Manage and support cross-functional finance transformation projects in partnership with IT, business operations, regional finance teams and external consultants, as needed.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including Finance Leadership and Internal Audit, as well as external auditors, to align on process goals and ensure operational readiness.

• Continuous Improvement: Establish a culture of continuous improvement by regularly soliciting feedback, conducting process reviews, analyzing performance data and introducing best practices.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in finance operations, including at least 2–3 years in a management consulting or finance transformation role.

• Proven experience leading global finance initiatives in a matrixed, multinational environment.

• Strong project management skills; experience with Lean, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Familiarity with automation and AI technologies

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority.

Preferred Experience

• Strong knowledge of finance processes, including procure-to-pay (P2P), order-to-cash (O2C) and record-to-report (R2R).

• Experience with ERP systems including Microsoft Dynamics 365, and finance automation tools.

• Proficiency in process mapping tools, such as Microsoft Visio.

• Proven experience developing, writing and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed process documentation.

• Familiarity with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in a shared services or global business services (GBS) environment.

Key Competencies

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving

• Strong finance acumen

• Process mindset and attention to detail

• Project management and execution

• Influencing and cross-functional collaboration

What the role offers

You will contribute to global standards with practical relevance to local teams, work across finance, business operations and technology, and help strengthen the foundations for scalable ways of working. The role offers exposure to varied business challenges and the opportunity to see your analysis become clearer processes, stronger controls and less rework.

Your role will report directly into Head of Global finance processes

About us

Scan Global Logistics is a Nordic-based full-service global logistics provider present on all continents. From businesses across all industries to life-saving humanitarian organizations, we go above and beyond to bring anything anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean or air.

We are guided by our fundamental virtues of Respect, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, and Fun and strive to bring a human approach to everyone, everywhere.

We run on the energy of good people, and no system or formula can compensate for that. Therefore, we also do what we can to unlock every employee's personal and professional potential so we can grow and thrive together.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and application in english. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the process when the right candidate has been found.

For further information, please contact Shaina Bano, Head of Global Finance Processes, UP Process Lead, +45 7181 7413 or visit www.scangl.com.

The Head of Tender Management Europe reports to the Global Head of Tender Management with a dotted line to the Regional CCO. The Head of Tender Management Europe leads and manages the most complex new and existing tender projects for global strategic accounts owned by headquarters and regional sales and contributes to the continuous improvement of SGL’s tender management model. The objective to generate revenue by winning new customers and protect existing business is crucial. The Head of Tender Management Europe leads cross-functional teams during the entire project life cycle, from initial evaluation of an opportunity to final deliverables. Above all, the Head of Tender Management Europe provides timely and insightful business analysis to decision-makers for each opportunity.

YOUR ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead strategic, complex tender opportunities during the entire project life cycle, from initial evaluation of an opportunity to final delivery.

• Qualify and analyze incoming bid material against corporate Tender Management criteria. Integrate and synthesize information from many sources (bid documents, conversations, emails, reports, etc.).

• Lead Tender opportunities as the project manager. Collaborate with others to accurately and comprehensively define project scope and deliverables to satisfy customer requirements.

• Clearly communicate project strategy, requirements, action items, etc. Mostly via email, MS teams, and telephone.

• Customize and integrate complex pricing spreadsheets to collect, process, and validate massive quantities of pricing and related data.

• Play an active and decisive role in winning new customers and protecting existing customers.

• Provide timely and insightful business analysis to decision-makers for each opportunity.

• Lead tender opportunities as the project manager, collaborate with senior colleagues to accurately and comprehensively define project scope and deliverables to satisfy customer requirements.

• Function as the primary point of contact between SGL internal sales teams, regional product teams, and customers.

• Simultaneously manage and monitor several tender projects according to set timelines and agreed processes.

• Develop internal pricing rate sheets and compile industry charges from different sources.

• Review and analyze feedback from the SGL network to ensure accuracy, competitiveness, avoiding errors and delays.

• Perform a variety of financial and statistical analysis to evaluate profitability, risk exposure, “what if” scenarios such as consolidation, etc. for each opportunity.

• Perform, analyze and evaluate customer data as part of Tender projects to identify value for customers and suggest improvements.

• Develop competitive quotation and proposal responses for SGL’s key customer targets.

• Member of the regional commercial management team.

• Proactively support Tender Management improvements regarding process, collaboration, and tools.

• Act as knowledge and counseling center for local pricing and tender management units.

YOUR PROFILE / QUALIFICATIONS

• At least 5 years of experience in freight forwarding industry.

• At least 5 years of experience in managing global Air and Ocean freight tenders.

• Experience from having worked on the customer side is a plus.

• Experience in business analytics, finance and pricing.

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration or Logistics (or equivalent) is a plus.

• Preference for knowledge or experience in logistics and transportation industry (sales or operations)

• Profound functional know-how in global transportation. Especially in air and ocean freight.

• Experience from rail and road freight is a plus.

• Preference for knowledge or experience with Project or Program Management.

• Deep understanding of operational forwarding processes.

• Proficient with MS-Office products, especially MS Excel, where advanced skills and experience are required.

• Preference for experience using web-based sourcing and procurement tools, for example, Jaggaer, GT Nexus, Ariba, Transporeon, Keelvar, Coupa, etc.

• Experience with Databases, data query, API, and/or ERP systems is a plus.

• Ability to leverage data-driven insights, automation and AI to improve workflows and processes is a plus.

• The location of the role is flexible but intended to be within Europe

• Fluency in English (written and verbal communication). Other language(s) is a plus.

• Excellent communication skills and international mindset.

• Profound skill in reading, interpreting and analyzing RFI and RFQ documents.

• Result oriented and customer focused personality with extremely good analytical skills.

• Proficient project management skills and business acumen.

• Ability to establish workload priorities and balance diverse tasks.

• Personality with strong leadership and organizing skills.

• Personality with a collaborative approach to creatively solving problems in a team.

• Must have strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence leadership, project stakeholders, by driving alignment under tight deadlines

This position is open to all candidates across Europe.

Contact person: Mike Lopez, MLope@scangl.com

Scan Global Logistics is a Global full-service logistics provider headquartered in the Nordic, who excel in uncomplicating logistics through tailored solutions made by skilled specialists, proud problem-solvers and passionate entrepreneurs.

Since 1975, the core of our DNA has been a ‘can-do-attitude’, agility and the willingness to always go the extra mile and we are not afraid to go left when others go right. For us, every challenge is an opportunity. We go above and beyond to bring anything to anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean, air or any other modes of transportation.

About Superb:

At Superb, we set out to empower restaurant businesses worldwide with an easier way of working. Running a hospitality business is hard work, and using multiple systems is not making it easier. Until now…

Superb gathers all the tools to open, run and grow your business — in one platform.

From reservations, orders and payments to digital gift cards, takeaway and guest marketing. You name it, we’ve got it. Finally, hospitality owners can free up time to focus on what matters while using data to serve magical experiences, build guest relationships, and maximise revenue. Superb’s all-in-one platform is used by +1000 hospitality businesses worldwide, and we are just getting started. Our internal team consists of talented people who are passionate about challenging the status quo and creating magical guest experiences. Do you want to embark with us on our mission to become the leading platform within hospitality?

The Superb opportunity:

We are scaling our fantastic Nordic sales team and would love to welcome more Superbians to join our mission in revolutionising the hospitality industry.

In this role you will be responsible for growing our customer base and revenue in the Nordics, with the mission of making Superb the #1 platform for hospitality businesses in your market.

To achieve this mission, you will be using a consultative sales approach. You will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new hospitality businesses such as restaurants, bars and cafes in your territory. These are a tight-knit community where everyone knows each other and therefore you will be strong in building customer relationships to expand your network with recommendations and referrals. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build and grow the Superb brand in your geographic territory. .

What you will do:

• 
Lead the charge introducing Superb to hospitality businesses in your territory

• 
Oversee the sales cycle from prospect, demo to close

• 
Achieve and exceed monthly sales goals through outbound sales efforts

•

Shape the future of Global Benefits Management across the Nordics – building on a strong client portfolio, accelerating growth, raising our market profile and developing the next generation of Nordic GBM talent.

The Role

Lead WTW’s Nordic Global Benefits Management business within Integrated & Global Solutions. This high-impact role combines market leadership, business development, client management and people leadership across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. As a visible senior representative of WTW, you will build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers and help multinational organisations turn global benefits strategies into action.

This is a market-facing growth role. You will originate, shape and convert significant GBM opportunities across the Nordic region while protecting and expanding WTW’s existing client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape the market – Be a recognised voice for GBM across the Nordics and strengthen WTW’s profile with multinational employers, external advisers and internal stakeholders.

• Accelerate growth – Build and convert a sustainable, multi-year Nordic pipeline, winning significant new GBM mandates and creating a stronger platform for long-term growth.

• Lead priority pursuits and client relationships – Shape compelling value propositions, navigate complex commercial discussions and help teams convert major opportunities into long-term mandates. Act as executive sponsor for selected priority clients, protecting renewals, expanding relationships and maintaining continuity from the sales process through implementation and ongoing delivery.

• Connect the best of WTW – Bring together capabilities and people from different parts of WTW to address complex client needs across the Nordics and beyond.

• Ensure excellent delivery – Provide oversight across client engagements, helping teams deliver against agreed objectives, quality standards, budgets and timelines.

• Grow our people – Coach and mentor Nordic GBM colleagues, strengthen commercial capability, support succession planning and develop future leaders.

Qualifications

About you

You are an established senior leader with deep knowledge of the Nordic market, a strong network and a proven record of delivering growth. Strategic and hands-on in equal measure, you build credibility quickly with C-suite executives, international benefits leaders and colleagues at every level.

Experience and capabilities

• 10+ years’ experience advising multinational organisations on global or regional employee benefits programmes and related consulting services.

• A strong record of winning complex engagements, meeting sales and utilisation goals, and building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the Nordic market.

• Demonstrated success managing major client relationships, leading cross-country teams and delivering multiple high-quality projects on time and within budget.

• A confident professional presence, with polished written and verbal communication skills.

• Sound judgement, strong problem-solving skills and the flexibility to diagnose issues and move them towards resolution.

• The ability to see the bigger picture, connect capabilities across practices and turn data into clear insights and practical solutions.

• A genuine commitment to coaching, training and mentoring colleagues.

• Confidence using Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, together with AI-enabled tools.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel across the Nordic region and internationally as required.

• International work or living experience and foreign-language skills are welcome but not essential.

What we offer

Join a collaborative international team with a strong client portfolio and significant room to grow. You will have the platform to shape WTW’s Nordic GBM strategy, build a high-performing regional business and make a visible contribution to our ambitions. We offer flexible working arrangements and a competitive total rewards package, including performance-related and locally relevant benefits.

About WTW and IGS

WTW combines data, insight and expertise to create solutions across people, risk and capital.

You will join WTW’s Integrated & Global Solutions (IGS) team and be based in the Copenhagen or Stockholm area, with flexibility around location.

IGS brings together more than 350 colleagues across WTW’s global network to address the headquarters needs of multinational clients. We help organisations navigate the business, cultural, linguistic and regulatory complexities of operating across markets.

Equal Opportunity Employer

WTW is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and locations.

jobs.occupation: Mid Software Engineer | OTC Product Area, Fintech Solutions
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

Why This Role is Important to Us

We are looking for Software Engineers at middle level to join our engineering team that builds fintech solutions for managing OTC (Over-The-Counter) financial instruments within our asset management platform, SimCorp Dimension and SimCorp One. Our work delivers value in two major areas. First, we implement new features that drive the business forward and shape the future of our platform. Second, we focus on extending and maintaining our established solutions to ensure our clients’ operations remain uninterrupted and always available.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• 
Designing, building, and extending existing solutions and APIs for our OTC asset management product, delivering value to customers incrementally.

• 
Working primarily in C#. Our codebase also includes OCaml and APL therefore prior experience with these languages is a strong plus.

• 
Understanding, refactoring and modernizing our legacy codebase without disrupting the business it supports.

• 
Focusing on the systems as a whole and being able address fundamental changes that improves the quality, performance and user experience.

• 
Collaborating closely with your product owner to refine requirements, clarify business needs, and shape how features get built.

• 
Working as part of a team of skilled engineers — pairing, reviewing code, and sharing ownership of the solution with fellow engineers.

• 
Following good engineering practice: clean code, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• 
Building, extending and consuming REST APIs.

• 
Communicating clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

• 
Continuously learning — and helping the team and product grow with you.

Required Skills & Experience

• Interest in creating innovative features for a complex platform, working on areas such as API scalability, automation, performance, and operational resilience - having space to explore, design and influence the final solution.

• Good C# skills. This is the core language for the role; your level of seniority will determine how much ownership and architectural input you're expected to bring.

• Experience with, or genuine interest in, functional programming. Familiarity with OCaml, APL, F#, Standard ML, Scala or Haskell is a real advantage but not required — a willingness to learn is what matters most.

• Experience (or strong interest) in refactoring existing code and working with legacy systems.

• Good collaboration and communication skills, with fluency in English (written and spoken).

• A relevant degree (Computer Science or STEM) with demonstrated hands-on experience in software engineering.

Furthermore, We Value That You Are:

• motivated to work within the financial domain,

• comfortable working closely with a cross-functional team,

• willing to learn and pick up new languages and paradigms as needed,

• able to identify tech debt and help drive incremental improvement,

• a collaborative person willing to share knowledge and learn from your team members.

Our Team and Ways of Working

We deliver solution for large scale financial institutions with billions of dollars in managed assets. Therefore, our work impacts everyday of our customers operations. You will work in a small team of highly skilled engineers on whole SDLC process – from understanding customers' needs, through solutioning and design to coding, testing and maintaining our software. Our hybrid model of working includes two days (minimum) in our Copenhagen office and up to three days working remotely. Codebase includes a mix of C#, OCaml and APL which gives broad opportunities to upskill and drive your career with us. We invest a lot in your understanding of both the technical details of the solution and financial knowledge that will allow you to contribute to building the future of asset management.

Our Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work-life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP innovation sprints, where you have dedicated time per quarter to spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just one route — we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Next Steps

Please click below to apply. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Global Quality & Customer Value - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape how food safety and quality create tangible value for customers while influencing strategic decisions across a global ingredients business?

As our Senior Manager, Global Quality & Customer Value, you will bridge customer expectations, business strategy, regulatory compliance and food safety performance. Going beyond traditional quality assurance, you will act as a trusted adviser to customers and colleagues across Commercial, Operations, R&D and Supply Chain.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**In this strategic leadership role, you will translate customer food safety and quality requirements into clear business actions. You will build strong relationships with key customers, lead the Business Quality Management Team and ensure that food safety and quality considerations are embedded in commercial and operational decision-making. The role is based at our headquarters in Aarhus.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

**

• Build strong relationships with key customers, acting as the senior Food Safety and Quality representative and translating their requirements into effective business actions.

• Lead customer quality agreements, quality business reviews, complaints management and the coordination of customer audits with manufacturing sites.

• Lead the Business Quality Management Team and represent Arla Foods Ingredients in global technical forums, industry working groups and partnerships with relevant associations.

• Advise commercial and operational leadership teams, ensuring food safety and quality risks are mapped and considered in business decisions, growth initiatives and market expansion.

• Drive strategic initiatives and projects by managing interdependencies, resolving roadblocks, influencing relevant investment decisions and ensuring effective completion and handover.

• Support deploying strategic QEHS initiatives through AFI manufacturing sites and lead crisis management & quality incidents affecting customers.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You bring a relevant science or technical degree at master’s level, or equivalent competencies, together with at least five years of experience in quality, food safety and/or manufacturing within an international company. Your background may come from the food, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or another relevant industry. You have experience leading and engaging a skilled team and are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across different functions and levels of an organization.

You combine strong analytical capabilities with sound business understanding and can turn large amounts of complex information into clear, high-quality decision proposals. You communicate fluently in English and adapt your communication effectively, whether engaging with colleagues on the plant floor, senior executives, customers or external technical stakeholders.

To succeed in this role, you are particularly strong at building trusted relationships, navigating complexity and creating progress through collaboration. You approach change with curiosity and independence, remain grounded and interested in the people around you, and seek solutions that create value for all parties. You enjoy working towards ambitious goals both independently and alongside others in a dynamic international environment where priorities may evolve.

**What do we offer?

**You will take on a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence customer partnerships, business priorities and food safety and quality performance across an international organisation. Working closely with colleagues from Commercial, Operations, R&D and Supply Chain, you will help connect technical expertise with customer and business value.

We are committed to professional development and promoting from within. Our collaborative culture is designed to bring out the best in you, while giving you the opportunity to contribute to a global market leader that creates value for customers, consumers and the farmers who own us.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you would like to use your quality and food safety expertise to strengthen strategic customer partnerships and influence the future of our business, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

For additional information, please contact Director Liliana Cataneo at lilca@arlafoods.com.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

What we do

Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

Where we are

• 
Funded with 12+ months runway

• 
Several paying public-sector clients

• 
A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

• 
A team of 3. You'd be number 4.

The role

You'll be our first technical hire and will lead product and engineering. For now that means hands fully dirty: you write the code. No agencies, no outsourcing.

• 
Own the platform. Rust, Postgres, cloud, our RiderSurvey API, and the data pipelines from operators. You'll inherit a working MVP and decide what to keep, what to rebuild and what to build next.

• 
Make the big calls, including the language. We chose Rust deliberately: we think a strict compiler and type system are the right guardrails for building fast with AI. If you have a better argument for something else, convince us.

• 
Be AI-native. We expect you to use AI seriously in coding and every other technical task. That's how a team of four does the work of fifteen.

• 
Build agents that run the company with us, for account management, client reporting and forecasting.

• 
Grow into the science. Together with a future R&D lead, you'll work on the statistical significance of measured impacts and on forecasting how markets respond to incentives.

• 
Shape the product with the founders and our clients. You'll be in the room with transport authorities, not behind a ticket queue.

You

• 
Have minimum 4 years of relevant experience shipping production software, ideally backend or data-heavy systems

• 
Senior and still love writing code every day? Even better.

• 
Know Rust, or are genuinely motivated to go deep in it (not just "willing"). (We are not dogmatic about Rust, but we have a working platform built with care, so changing direction would take strong conviction.)

• 
Already build with AI tools daily and have opinions about how to do it well

• 
Are comfortable with data: SQL, pipelines, and an appetite for statistics and forecasting

• 
Take ownership when things are ambiguous, and like it when nobody tells you how

• 
Care about the mission. You don't need to have read our founder's book, The Next Democracy, but its core ideas about how citizens and governments could work together - is fundamental to what we do. If they don’t excite you, this probably isn't the right fit.

Bonus points for experience in mobility or transport, govtech, causal inference or experimentation, or privacy-by-design and GDPR.

What we offer

• 
A real say in everything. Stack, product, architecture, culture and who we hire next.

• 
Title decided together. We're advertising this as CTO / Founding Engineer and will settle the title with you based on your experience and ambitions.

• 
Competitive startup salary plus a meaningful warrant package, designed to make total compensation comparable with bigger-company offers

• 
5 weeks of holiday and flexible hours

• 
Work that matters. Help redirect public money towards what actually improves people's lives.

Location

Copenhagen is our home, and we'd love you here; relocation is very welcome. If you stay elsewhere, you must be based in the EU and work in EU time zones. You'd spend your first 1–2 months with us in Copenhagen, then 2–4 days here every month after that.

Process

• 
Quick online intro call with Erdem (CEO)

• 
In-person meeting

• 
A challenge based on a real problem from our platform

• 
Second meeting with the team

Impact Market facilitates payments for outputs, and allows public institutions to pay for the projects that create the outcomes they seek.
